en: Mersenne
"Ahh! Namina is right before my eyes!"{w}
"Lord Mersenneee!"{w}
note: Namina's [JP] = 'Lord Mersenne' throughout, parallel to 'Lord Semnadoc' so the 'number one / number two' payoff lands.

en: "Are you in good health, Namina?"{w}
note: Mersenne addresses her by name as topic ([JP]); rendered as second person plus name.

en: "Yes, I'm in good health!"{w}

"Are you studying, Namina?
Are you working hard?"{w}
"Yes, I'm studying and working hard!"{w}
"And our happiness?"{w}
"We owe it all to Semnadoc!"{w}
"And who matters most to us!?"{w}
note: Editorial: tightened; now echoes 6199 "the one who matters most to me" word for word.

en: "It's Semnadooc!"{w}
note: [JP] elongation carried as a stretched vowel. | Accuracy: 'Lord' dropped per lead convention (no Lord/Lady for Semnadoc, gender not established); source has plain [JP] as elsewhere in the scene.

en: "Hmm, splendid, Namina!"{w}

Just then, a Mersenne card fluttered
out of Namina's sleeve.{w}
note: The souvenir woodblock card of Mersenne shown in slice_028 (6088).

en: "...Hm? What is that?"{w}
"...Lord Mersenne?"{w}

"Tell me,
do you truly revere Semnadoc?"{w}
note: [JP] as a pointed address: 'Tell me,'.

en:
"Y-yes...
I do revere Semnadoc... but...?"{w}
note: Object restored by repeating the name: Semnadoc's gender is unknown in the glossary, so no 'him'.

en:
"You told me you wish to work
at the Cathedral someday...{w}If you are merely a fan of mine, there is no need for you to come, you know."{w}
"Huh? Wh-what's gotten into you all of a sudden!?"{w}

note: [JP]: object read as Mersenne himself (follows 'merely a fan of mine'). Could conceivably mean meeting the god in prayer; flagged.

en:
"You would do well to think it over once more.{w}Ask yourself whether there is truly a reason
you must work at the Cathedral."{w}
note: Second half is a dangling clause in JP ([JP]...[JP]); verb 'Think about' restored. | Editorial: "think it over... Think about" repetition and "have a reason you must" reworded; same meaning.

en: "But, Lord Mersenne!?"{w}
"I am not angry.{w}I am warning you for your own sake.{w}...Farewell!!"{w}

Without so much as a glance at Namina, who was
chasing after him, Mersenne left for the Cathedral.{w}
note: Editorial: "the pursuing Namina" (calqued prenominal) reworded. | proof: 'she' removed; Namina takes no pronoun (review_notes batch 020-029; lead note on 6218).

en: "Lord Mersenne..."{w}

"Maybe I really was
starry-eyed over Lord Mersenne..."{w}
note: [JP] = blinded/dazzled by him.

en: "...What do I do?"{w}{p}"Is it really okay for me to keep going like this?{w}Do I really need to work at the Cathedral...?{w}I just don't know anymore..."{w}
note: Accuracy: [JP] is about carrying on down her current path (cf. the next sentence), not self-acceptance; 'Am I okay the way I am?' shifted the meaning.

en:
"Mersenne doesn't go easy
even on those who are fond of him, eh.{w}Mind you, that strictness is what makes him an archbishop..."{w}
note: [JP] = plain 'Mersenne' in Kine's old-woman voice. | Editorial: [JP] framed as his worth ([JP]); "rigidity" read as a fault -> "strictness".

en: "Kine, I..."{w}
note: [JP] = plain 'Kine'.

'dearie' added for Kine's old-woman register ([JP]); remove in editorial pass if unwanted. | Editorial: added "dearie" dropped (not in source; Kine never uses it elsewhere, she says "youngster" to the party); "decide, facing your own heart" reworded.

en: "...I'll go."{w}
"I'm going to go stand under the falls!!"{w}

"Don't you talk such foolishness!{w}You know full well how dangerous
the land has become right now!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'you're not one who wouldn't understand' -> 'You of all people must know'. | Editorial: "of all people" added emphasis the source lacks (accuracy item) -> "You know full well".

en:
"But if things stay like this, I can't stand before
Lord Mersenne with my head held high!"{w}

"But with the wicked ones
so active right now..."{w}
note: Deliberate trail-off kept.

en:
"It's fine! These adventurers here
will take care of them for me!{w}Right!?"{w}
note: [JP] addressed to the party.

en: "Oh, I see! Now that's a fine idea!!"{w}

You've been made Namina's bodyguards
without anyone asking you.{w}
note: [JP]; 'her' = Namina (female per glossary).

en:
"Everyone, please go on ahead and wait for me!{w}Once I'm ready, I'll come to the basin
below Moonlight Falls too!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'the basin below Moonlight Falls' (new phrase, used consistently in 6172/6173/6175).

en:
Somehow it's been settled that you'll meet Namina
at the basin below Moonlight Falls.{w}
note: Accuracy: [JP] = it ended up arranged (without the party's say, cf. 6170 [JP]); 'agreeing' implied consent the source does not give. | proof: 'her' -> name; Namina takes no pronoun (review_notes batch 020-029).

en: "Everyone, it's the basin below Moonlight Falls!{w}I'm counting on you!"{w}

"I was just thinking of going
to see Lord Mersenne.{w}Would you come with me?"{w}
You followed Namina to the Cathedral.{w}
"Lord Mersenne!"{w}
"Hm. Namina."{w}

"Lord Mersenne, I need to talk to you
about the other day!"{w}

"Very well,
then please wait a little while."{w}{p}"There is someone over there
in need of an oracle,
so I will see you after that."{w}
note: [JP] = 'oracle'; [JP] completed as 'I will see you after that'.

en: You waited for Mersenne together with Namina.{w}

"Thank you for waiting.
Now then, Namina.{w}Have you found some sort of answer?"{w}
"...Please, go on."{w}

"I remembered.{w}The day you came to my village,
Lord Mersenne."{w}{p}"You said smiles bring happiness...{w}That it's when times are hard
that a smile matters most..."{w}{p}"I longed to follow those teachings of Semnadoc,
so I came to this holy land."{w}
note: 'You said' restored for the quoted teaching ([JP]...); the teaching is credited to Semnadoc in the last page.

en: Mersenne is nodding.{w}
"So the one who matters most to me is...{w}Semnadoc!{w}Not you, Lord Mersenne!!"{w}
note: Echoes 6111 ([JP]).

en:
"Gaaaaah!?"{w}{p}"N-Namina...{w}You would cast aside this Mersenne
and call Semnadoc number one...!?"{w}{p}"Am I not Namina's number one!?"{w}
note: [JP] (shock sound, said aloud) -> 'Gaaaaah!?'. Mersenne's theatrical self-reference [JP] kept as 'this Mersenne'.

en: "That's right! It's not you!!"{w}
note: Editorial: "Yes" to the negative question in 6201 reads as a contradiction in English -> "That's right!" (accuracy item).

en:
"We of the clergy must devote ourselves
to the gods and to the happiness of all."{w}

"To serve is to wear away
one's own happiness and life.{w}Without that resolve, one cannot be a servant of the gods."{w}
note: [JP]: [JP] read as plural to match [JP] in 6209.
Editorial: clunky "You have realized this, and so, ... you have taken" reworded; same content.

en: "Lord Mersenne...{w}Thank you for your guidance..."{w}

Eyes welling with tears,
Namina bowed to Mersenne.{w}
"Ah, Semnadoc!{w}Namina has chosen the right path!{w}Please, give Namina your praise!!"{w}
note: Lead: kept the name (no pronoun for Namina until the script settles her gender; review_notes).

en: "Lord Mersenneee!"{w}

The joyful voices of the two of them
rang out through the Cathedral.{w}

"When the new year comes, I'm going to take
the Cathedral's ordination exam."{w}{p}"I probably won't pass on the first try,
but I'll keep trying again and again,
and I will pass, you'll see."{w}
note: [JP] = 'ordination exam' (exam to enter the priesthood); same exam as the [JP] in 6134.

en: "Semnadoc is number one.{w}
note: Source row has an opening quote and no closing one (fragment/alt version of 6227); kept as is.
♪ -> '~'. {0E}/{0F} highlight kept around the first sentence. | Editorial: [JP]♪ aligned with Namina's "ehehe~" in 6085 (slice_028).

en: Caron

note: New name [JP] = 'Caron Branch'. [JP] = 'Ugh, quit nagging.' [JP] = 'customer' (matches Lunea's usage in slice_018). Caron's self-reference by name kept ('run by Caron').

en:
"My shop carries goods that combine
both style and function."{w}
note: [JP] = 'style and function'.

en:
"But just selling them off
doesn't make much of a profit.{w}Now, what should I do..."{w}

"Making new goods to match
each season's trends --
that's my motto."{w}{p}"I mean, every shop lines up
the same old stuff all year round.
There's nothing fun about it."{w}

"Why doesn't anyone notice, I wonder?{w}Now, what's the trend this season?
If there isn't one, I'll just make one myself!"{w}
"Hmmm... reliability, huh..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'reliability' (Caron musing; leads into the practicality-proof request in slice_030).

en:
Caron is deep in thought,
arms folded.{w}
note: No pronoun needed; Caron's gender unknown.

en: "Oh, welcome.{w}...I know, maybe I'll ask you lot?"{w}
note: [JP] = 'you lot'.

en:
"Hey, can you keep your mouth shut? Can you keep a secret?
You know, that confidentiality thing."{w}
